collection.title: Audi A4 Avant 2008 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a the Audi A4 Avant 2008 to 2015 which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this A4 Avant which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
